paragraphs: I am applying for the Field and Laboratory Engineer role (reference 38009) at your Ravenhall facility, advertised on the Tonkin + Taylor careers site. Ravenhall is a short drive from my home in Melton, and a role that mixes fieldwork, laboratory testing and careful records is the work I want to build on.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and my coursework drew on Australian Standards including AS 1289 and AS 1726. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019), which covered construction methods, hydraulics and surveying.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. Later, at Concentrix, I resolved 40 to 60 technical cases a day and kept accurate case notes.

I have not done construction materials testing, soil logging or NATA laboratory work on a job, so I would be learning your test methods and quality system from the start. I hold a White Card (Construction Induction), an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, which covers the six month term.
I've attached my resume. I would be glad to talk about the role on 0478 764 077, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
